s3.p45.eng: If we were to send only one callback to the **task queue** using the **⟦f13⟧** method, then all timer callbacks would get into the **Call Stack** before the last microtask got into the **microtask queue**.

s3.p46.eng: To “even the odds,” the timer callback sets the timer again. Then the situation in the **task queue** will be similar to the **microtask queue**.
